claude.performance_metric: no public record for outcome window; deregistered April 2013 after ~$700m merger
claude.rationale: The slice states that after Danfoss A/S completed the ~$700 million tender-offer/short-form merger (effective April 12, 2013) and the Company deregistered via Form 15-12B on April 29, 2013, no standalone public audited financials, annual reports, or periodic disclosures exist for the ~2015–2017 window. The slice explicitly notes that "No documented disruption or continuity at the product/process or process/organization interface can be sourced for the outcome window" and marks that line [UNVERIFIED]. Because no realized-outcome evidence about either interface is publicly observable, both p4 and p5 are coded uncertain rather than 0.

grok.rationale: The slice states that no documented disruption or continuity at the product/process interface can be sourced for the ~2015–2017 outcome window, because the acquirer did not separately disclose the acquired business’s trajectory in any public U.S. filing. Likewise, no documented disruption at the process/organization interface is sourced for that window. Absence of documented pathway evidence is therefore coded 0 for both p4 and p5; the post-deal performance scalar is also not publicly observable after the 2013 deregistration.
